tango.basis: Crooked rear-load anticipation visibly precedes pelvis/root drive; torso then shoulder/arm sling accelerates. Object remains hand-adjacent through authored RELEASE_GATE and forks only on the next authored FREE key, before the arm reaches its later follow-through extrema. Front-side support absorbs the throw, rear support peels, counter-rotation and catch compression pay the force debt, and recovery remains displaced rather than returning to idle.

noodle_queen.inspection_scope: same final 50-frame authoritative render plus complete three-part specimen structure
noodle_queen.basis: The rear-loaded corkscrew, withheld object release, hard object/body clock fork, cross-body spill, front-catch compression and crooked displaced recovery form a specific throw attitude. Force transfer and custody are legible without source choreography, and the ending carries debt instead of politely resetting.
